title: Docs
description: Sidenav grouping and doc-page chrome for the /docs section.

fields.label: Show hydration tier badge
fields.description: Shows a doc's Tier 1/2/3 hydration badge next to its category badge on the doc page. This is an implementation detail (see the Hydration guide) — turn it off if your readers don't need to know it.

fields.label: Fallback group label
fields.description: Sidenav group label used for any doc that doesn't match one of the configured groups (by section or category). Defaults to "Other".

fields.label: Explicit doc order
fields.description: Doc slugs, in the exact order they should appear within their sidenav group. Any doc not listed here keeps alphabetical order, appended after these.

fields.label: Header / pager labels
fields.description: Button and pager copy on doc pages: the Edit/Admin buttons (deep-link into the CMS), the mobile menu disclosure toggle, and the Previous/Next doc pager at the bottom of each doc.
